steps: Turn off power at the breaker and verify with a non-contact voltage tester.
Remove the cover plate and unscrew the outlet from the electrical box.
Note wire positions (black=hot, white=neutral, bare/green=ground) before disconnecting.
Connect wires to matching terminals on the new outlet.
Push the outlet into the box, secure it, replace the cover, and restore power.
